requested: Close the valid committed v025 receipt rejection during checkpoint-v20 save

source_edits.scope: Checkpoint receipt identity routing and persistence tests

repository_discipline.rationale: The plan repairs the existing transaction persistence Pinch Point without adding a second identity owner.

dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: Existing checkpoint builders select the exact receipt identity; the existing validator remains its sole owner.

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: The payload helper gains one explicit expected identity and returns the same validated transaction payload.

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: Checkpoint builders depend on stable contract identities and no simulator or training internals are introduced.

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: Committed, idle, partial, incompatible, save, and reload states are included.

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: Effect Sketch is limited to checkpoint identity builders, transaction payload validation, and persistence tests.

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Offline persistence closure does not claim policy quality or a successful post-fix live run.

dimensions.name: proof-route
dimensions.evidence: Exact RED/GREEN committed save, scalar characterization, mixed rejection, reload, aggregate suite, and official preflight are required.

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: No model tensor changes; persisted Actor/normalizer/Replay tensors retain checkpoint-v20 ownership.

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: The repair occurs after the exact-one Actor update and does not touch optimizer or gradients.

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: A real committed receipt, atomic save, strict identity inspection, and fresh reload are the primary proof.

residual_risks: A fresh real post-fix checkpoint write remains user-controlled runtime evidence.
